notes.title: Build Update
notes.notes:
- Quest system completely reworked under the hood to make it easier to expand with new quests and polish existing ones. Previously it was one massive quest system, now changed to a modular approach  
- Added UI for quest tracking with journal records  
- UI polishing continues, a few steps closer to full gamepad support  
- Reworked detection logic for enemy AI – detection now depends on whether the player is standing or crouching, and if wearing equipment that affects visibility  
- Equipment now has CAMOUFLAGE modifiers – larger numbers mean the player can be detected from shorter distances. Stance and movement also affect detection chance  
- Starting area level art update  
- Some level art work on the global map  
- Added new UNI set for uniforms  
- Added new animation for sprinting with rifle  
- Small fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Gamepad integration update
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you everyone for the feedback! I've made some progress with gamepad integration, and it can now be tested in-game.

I've implemented a Bloodborne/Souls-like target lock system that activates automatically when a gamepad is in use. To lock onto a target, press the aim input in the direction of the enemy, and the system will lock the camera. It should feel familiar. You can switch targets or unlock by pressing the aim input again.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/e1f926c4fac39ae23baa9f0cfcceb840515b8eb4.png"][/img]
Please note that aim lock does not work when using a keyboard and mouse. I plan to add it as an optional feature in the future, but it will be disabled by default.

Some default control mappings have also been updated. The game still requires a keyboard and mouse for certain menu interactions, so this isn’t full controller support yet. Your feedback would be greatly appreciated!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/fba3797505c8b23c28b986bfc4c8c02fbe81636c.png"][/img]
As an additional note, cloud saves have now been enabled.[/p]

notes.title: Major Engine Update V_6f5
notes.notes:
Engine Update – Unreal Engine 5.5.4

A major engine upgrade from 5.2 to 5.5.4. This brings a number of changes under the hood—from physics to rendering. The goal is to improve performance and provide more stable framerates across different systems.

Update notes:

-    Engine upgraded from 5.2 to 5.5.4
-    Updated AMD FSR
-    Removed overly sensitive ragdoll trigger when rolling near edges or falling from small heights
-   Ragdoll fixes for enemies and NPCs
-    Some texture size optimization
-    Various small fixes and improvements

🛠️ Please note: Due to the engine upgrade, this update may require a large download. Apologies for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

📈 Looking forward to the next Unreal Engine 5.6 update—Epic promises a significant performance boost in rendering, which should further improve stability and frame rates.

notes.title: Build Update V_6f4
notes.notes:
Short-Term Contracts System. Second iteration

The Contracts system has been updated! You can now take on short, standalone missions from certain NPCs and from Shrines of Death Wishes.

🗺️ Two small levels have been added to test the system:

    One mission is available from the Merchants of Death, west of the old farm

    Another from the Shrine of Death Wishes, east of the Meeting Point (near the “Parcel” quest)

🧭 Contracts can now be tracked from the menu—making it easier to follow your objectives.

🎒 As a reward, you can unlock a new Austrian-style backpack!

🛠️ Also included:

    General performance improvements for enemy AI

    System groundwork for future contract content

A quick note: while recent work may not have been immediately visible, this system is a major step toward enriching the gameplay loop. Verden is a world at war, and sometimes someone just needs an extra hand—and that might be you.

📅 More updates coming Friday!

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Trench Tales is now live in Early Access. I wanted to take a moment to thank everyone who’s supported the project so far, and also to say a few words for those just discovering it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/46305c9b8313c6abb03064486452ec2fc6da6e71.png[/img]

The game is still in active development, and you’ll notice some unfinished content and rough edges. That’s expected at this stage, and there’s more to come—new content, polish, improvements, and fixes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/bb534413f4ae3602039e10d21ec280ba1d91d6c6.png[/img]

If you’ve already picked up the game, or are considering it—thanks a lot. It really means something to see people showing interest in a project like this.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/9a21298905db6eb47737a2377b10f2f74834b937.png[/img]
While I started this solo, over time, feedback from players has helped shape the game in ways I didn’t expect. That input has made a real difference, and if you’re the kind of person who enjoys being part of that process, you’re very welcome to join in. There’s a Discord, and I try to keep everything open—updates, ideas, bugs, and progress.
For anyone unsure, the public playtest will remain free and available. It might receive updates with a bit of delay compared to the main Early Access build, since my focus will be on the core branch—but I’ll keep updating it regularly. It will stay open for everyone, so you can always try it before deciding whether to buy the full version.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/00e6566d93f440d844e9404ee0c60839432f69b7.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for your time and support. I hope you enjoy what’s already here—and what’s still ahead.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/7fef8bda3d9c6a92528b13c3c51160c367773181.png[/img]

New Regular Update for Trench Tales – Alpha 2
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/24b8e63b5932ac14516a7613553d45e08a3b74fa.jpg[/img]
Hello, good soldiers! The latest update for Trench Tales is here, and it includes some key changes. Destructible vehicles and heavy weapons have been added, making combat more dynamic. Weather effects and updated VFX bring new life to the environments, and special skills have been adjusted for better balance. I've also cleaned up bugs and added fresh assets to improve the overall experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/9e681a6e8da6a4d576c03efa3a013ac196a2ad42.png[/img]
Additionally, check out the new character concept art, giving a first look at some of the figures that will soon join the fight.

You can view the updates in the trailers below:

Direct Gameplay Trailer
 [previewyoutube=2oHhalIb2UM;full][/previewyoutube]

    
Stylized Cinematic Trailer 
[previewyoutube=VuovFJKETbQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your continued support! You can now find supporter packs available at trenchtales.com. Keep moving forward!

notes.title: One Month after opening Alpha access
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
One month passed since opening the gate for Alpha access. More than 1200 people now can play the game, provide feedback and be a part of the development process. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/de7c2f2fdd9950db7d25558356e39fe9a67e01f3.jpg[/img]
I would like to say a huge thank you to everyone for your support. This is a very special period of my life and I am so happy now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43185066/a2cc3ddbd63ccc2bbb54126d3d95947680f43d6c.jpg[/img]
Still a long path ahead but the project has a good development velocity and I have a good feeling about delivering it in good shape and on time.
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1266202853668687904/1279788294372327485/ScreenShot00495.png?ex=66d902fa&is=66d7b17a&hm=57b94f16af8435c1462d67f91bb4f5e9484625283bf2e3cf7b389aad0c82dd62&[/img]
Some more news will be announced next week but for now, I would like to share with you this Teaser/Trailed video about what has been done during last month. This is my first attempt to do such things. Please let me know what you think.
[previewyoutube=Lf0fqH01euE;full][/previewyoutube]
https://youtu.be/Lf0fqH01euE
Thank you!

notes.title: Trench Tales is LIVE on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

I'm thrilled to announce that Trench Tales is now live on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/trenchtales/trench-tales]Kickstarter[/url]! It's been an incredible journey, and I'm deeply grateful for this moment. Drop by the campaign to explore exclusive Kickstarter rewards and secure your copy of the game. Your support means everything to me, and I can't wait to share this adventure with you. Thank you for being a part of this exciting chapter!
